LanguageData.UR_Settings_BarHeader: Show retainers in the colonist bar:
LanguageData.UR_Settings_BarAllDesc: Retainers appear in the colonist bar like normal colonists (vanilla behavior). The bar gets crowded with many retainers.
LanguageData.UR_Settings_BarCombatDesc: Hidden normally; shown while drafted, downed, reforming, injured and needing treatment, or in a mental break.
LanguageData.UR_Settings_BarNoneDesc: Retainers never appear in the colonist bar. Manage them from the Undying Retainers roster.
